episodes.title: MMC: The Internet's Most Disturbing Cult
episodes.description:
An online cult turned violence into an application process, propaganda, and a ranking system.

This is the disturbing story of MMC, also known as Maniac Murder Cult, and how an internet-born extremist network spread from attack videos and Telegram propaganda to international law enforcement investigations.

The story begins with Yegor Krasnov, known online as Maniac, whose violent persona helped shape the early mythology of MMC. But the group became far more organized under Michail Chkhikvishvili, also known as Commander Butcher, a recruiter and propagandist who helped turn MMC into something more structured, more international, and more dangerous.

In this documentary, we trace the full timeline of MMC, from its roots in Ukraine and extremist online spaces, to the Hater’s Handbook, the group’s recruitment methods, its use of propaganda, and the undercover FBI operation that stopped a planned attack in New York City.

We also look at how MMC-linked material continued to influence people around the world, including cases in Türkiye, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Sweden.

This is not just a story about an online cult. It is a story about how extremist communities use the internet to recruit, radicalize, reward violence, and turn real-world harm into content.
